parameters.apprise_url_plus: voipms://${ customer_secrets.{{ params.password_secret }} }:${ customer_secrets.{{ params.email_secret }} }/${ customer_secrets.{{ params.from_phone_secret }} }/${ customer_secrets.{{ params.targets_secret }} }
parameters.description:
`msg-to-voipms-sms` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your VoIPms destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through [Apprise](https://github.com/caronc/apprise), the open-source notification library, driven entirely by your own stored credentials at no cost. A paid variant ($0.001 per message) delivers to additional VoIPms destinations bound per enrollment.

Sign up at voip.ms, then enable API access and generate an API password at voip.ms/m/api.php — distinct from your account login password. Set your account email as VOIPMS_SMS_EMAIL and the API password as VOIPMS_SMS_PASSWORD. In your DID settings, enable SMS/MMS on the number you want to send from and set that number as VOIPMS_SMS_FROM_PHONE; set the recipient's number as VOIPMS_SMS_TARGETS.
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own VoIPms destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

email_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's VoIPms email

from_phone_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's VoIPms from phone

password_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's VoIPms password

targets_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's VoIPms targets
